notes: embedded: decode COSE, read x5chain (leaf and intermediate), validate the path to the root anchor (two verifications), verify signature

complete_* adds the cryptographic work of a full validation of one timestamped image: TSA signature, TSA path, SHA-256 of the content; assertion hashing, ingredient manifests, revocation and policy checks are not included
referenced: decode COSE, read x5t, resolve trust store, validate chain, verify signature
warm = certificate already in memory; cold = read from local trust store on disk
remote resolution is a network round trip and is deliberately not measured; add the deployment's own latency to the warm figure
the reference does not remove chain validation, it moves where the certificates come from
trade-off to state in the paper: offline verification of a signer the verifier has never seen is no longer possible
merged from 10 independent runs (fresh processes and keys, random experiment and configuration order); median_ms is the median of per-run medians, ci95_ms a 95% bootstrap interval over runs
